Hi @howie-f 

The latest push should capture JSON-RPC play attemps as well.

I've put the code where it is, rather than the common `PlayFile` function (which is the first shared function between the local path and the json path) - as if you put it there it breaks the fact you've unlocked music/videos when you go into the seperate video/music screens.

Hope this is OK.

## Bug report
### Master Lock code work around
Here is a clear and concise description of what the problem is:
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Hi,
My son has figured out a workaround for the master lock code to watch tv shows.
On the home screen he scrolls over to TV Shows and goes to up to recently added. He is able to play these files. He then marks these as played until the show he wants is shown.  This occurs on estuary and confluence.
Recently added could just be disabled , but it is a feature I enjoy.

Would it be possible to enable the master lock code for recently added?


## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The recently added thumbnail is visible on the home screen, when selected the master lock code is requested


## Actual Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The recently added thumbnail is visible on the home screen, when selected the video plays

<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix or reason for the bug -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->

1.  Go to TV shows on home screen
2. Select a recently added TV show
3. Video plays
